title: Are Vision Language Models Ready for Clinical Diagnosis? A 3D Medical Benchmark for Tumor-centric Visual Question Answering

bias_targets.methodology: Stratifying question-answering accuracy across different patient age groups extracted from scan metadata to identify age-related performance disparities.
Comparing model accuracy across female and male patient cohorts to evaluate sex-based performance differences.
Evaluating model performance variations across different CT scanner manufacturers and contrast phases to assess robustness to acquisition protocols.
